notes.title: NPC trainer rosters and story battles
notes.text: Named NPC trainers keep one fixed team with stable individuals; species never change and levels only rise. Asking an NPC to battle starts it from the next reply, including replies that narrate the start without metadata.

notes.title: Battle aftermath in the main chat
notes.text: Fainted Pokémon return to their balls and cannot act; the finished battle record reaches the main chat; departed opponents keep their chat headers; Continue story no longer replaces the reply.

notes.title: Game-version sprites and shiny odds
notes.text: Choose any of 38 sprite styles, from Gen I pixels to Scarlet & Violet HD models, for menus, battle and chat. Wild shiny odds are adjustable from 1/8192 to 1/20 and only affect Pokémon met afterwards.
